verdict.rationale: Brex has publicized AI-powered automation features (invoice entry, GL coding, expense assistant) and reportedly built a bot for querying expenses, but community discussion of that assistant includes a concrete hands-on failure — the bot gave an incorrect answer about the most recent receipt date, missing two later receipts — and skepticism about whether it's truly production-grade versus a demo/recruiting exercise. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a dedicated in-app conversational assistant with delegate-able task scope, and independent confirmation that it works reliably without hallucination.
